issue.title: claude: show the PR of the branch in the status line pill
issue.body:
## Why

The workbench mod writes a pill for the Claude Code status line. The pill must show the pull request of the branch. No branch has a pull request yet, so this part of the pill was never seen on a real pull request.

## What

- Open a pull request from the branch `feat/claude-vim-border`.
- Make sure that the pill shows the number and the state of the pull request.
- Make sure that the pill shows the approvals, the checks and the comments when they change.

## Done when

- The pill shows the pull request of the branch for an open, a draft and a merged pull request.
- The colors of the pill come from `dot_claude/palette.json`.
